tool.name: Mimarks.attributes
tool.description: Reads bioSample Attributes xml and generates source for get.mimarkspackage command
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$biosample_in' biosample_in.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #silent $mothur_args.append("xml=biosample_in.dat")
echo 'mimarks.attributes(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log
tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The ``mimarks.attributes`` command reads `BioSample Attributes`_ xml and writes the C++ source code in which mothur's own get.mimarkspackage_ implementation describes the MIMARKS packages. It is a helper for mothur developers, not an analysis step: the output is code, not data.
.. _BioSample Attributes: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/biosample/docs/attributes/ .. _get.mimarkspackage: https://mothur.org/wiki/get.mimarkspackage/
.. warning::
This tool therefore runs mothur 1.43.0, the last release in which the command works. Every version since 1.44 aborts with ``[ERROR]: this command doesn't create a source output file.`` and writes no ``source`` dataset, because upstream no longer declares the output type the command produces (current master is still affected). Once that is fixed the pin can be dropped and the tool moved back to the version of the rest of the suite. The fix is proposed upstream in `mothur PR 875`_.
.. _mothur PR 875: https://github.com/mothur/mothur/pull/875
